system.description: In some lands, you're known as a Swordsworn, a Steelhand, or a Blade Master. You don't care about a showy name—you just prefer to fight with a sword. You've fought with your sword for thousands of hours while training, in war, on expeditions, and during desperate battles in forgotten places of the world. Maybe you fight as a mercenary, for yourself, or as part of a group of adventurers. As long as you've got your sword, nothing can withstand you. You are up for a fight anytime, even when startled directly from sleep. Sword held high, you're ready to protect your allies, even if that means drawing your foes' attention. So be it; they'll meet you at your sword's edge.
